purpose: Independent literal task checks derived from requests, frozen before holdout execution. These complement domain, identity, effect and outcome assertions; they are not an LLM judge.

families.known: Compiled prompt must contain the exact literal text explicitly supplied after texto:
families.missing: Must ask and retain unresolved texto; compiled text must be absent
families.ambiguity: Must ask with at least two real candidates; never auto-select
families.duplicate: Must ask with at least two real candidates; never collapse identity
